name: Hadrianus
description: Archmagus of House Flambeau who sailed for Iceland in 1214 hunting the Order of Odin, was attacked by Pan Caudarax, fell into Twilight and drowned; his ghost later haunted a Scottish island.

name: Julius
description: Archmagus of House Flambeau and Ignem specialist who, with Lavinia, leads the Hermetic crusade against Iceland and kills Biorn Egilsson.

name: Lavinia
description: Archmaga and Quaesitor of House Guernicus, an Intellego specialist skilled in wards and necromancy, who calls the War Tribunal at Durenmar and co-leads the crusade.

name: Albinus
description: Archmagus of House Ex Miscellanea and Theban spirit master whose spells can defeat the Icelandic guardians; he may join the crusade or side with the hreppur.

name: Biorn Egilsson
description: Old galdraman and leader of the galdramen hreppur, slain by Julius on the Night of Tears after requesting a dialog in Latin.

name: Bard
description: Leader of the Icelandic giant community who opposes the Hermetic invasion and leads the assault on the crusaders' mystic tower.

name: Gull Hellirsson
description: Leader of the fire giants, a Jotunn of the Clan of Geirrod who wields a dwarf-forged warhammer able to break wards and seeks vengeance on Julius's forces.

name: Vigdis
description: Norn lady, an Orlog landvaettir lady, who warns the magi of Julius's planned attack on Scartaris and can grant landvaettir attendants.

name: Magnus Gizurarson
description: Bishop of Skalholt whose son is slain in the killings; he leads a delegation to Rome petitioning the Pope against the Order of Hermes and chairs the settlement.

name: Gunnar Loftursson
description: Neighboring bondi and church warden who seeks ond from Vindolanda's magi to save his gravely ill daughter.

name: Asta
description: Galdrakona wife of Gunnar Loftursson, targeted by the crusaders, who sustains a Biarg spirit with spell song to keep her daughter alive.

name: Iain
description: Vindolanda figure who can command the gate spirit to swallow the gatestone and seal off Scartaris from the mainland.

name: Prima of House Ex Miscellanea
description: Head of House Ex Miscellanea who refuses all outside contact while preparing for an apocalypse she has predicted for decades.

name: The Pope
description: Petitioned by Bishop Magnus in Rome; may excommunicate all Christian members of the Order of Hermes.

name: Pan Caudarax
description: Dragon and first guardian of Iceland who destroyed Hadrianus's ship; he can shapeshift into a lindorm or kraken and commands an attendant host.

name: Vindsvall
description: Iceland's second guardian, an immense storm-colored eagle spirit as old as the land, bound by the ancients to protect the island, with Weather Mastery and Spiritual Form.

name: The Gray Bull
description: Iceland's third guardian, a spirit bull tamed by the Dominion at Skalholt in 1105 and held as Bishop Magnus's stud; if freed it grows into a vast aurochs.

name: The Host
description: Around two thousand landvaettir attending the current guardian of Iceland, able to heal it, grant it Might, shapeshift and cast spell effects.

name: Landvaettir
description: Icelandic land spirits who watch the coasts, serve the guardians and bargain with galdramen; they pledge to avenge Biorn Egilsson.

name: Landvaettir lords
description: Powerful landvaettir who held the galdramen leader in esteem and give attendant spirits to all galdramen during the conflict.

name: Landvaettir attendant
description: Spirit given to each galdraman during the war, with Might equal to Song Talent x5, reducing casting time and accepting bargains for little vis.

name: Orlog spirits
description: Prophetic landvaettir (Norns) whose foresight coordinates the Icelandic assault and can help set ambushes.

name: Yfel spirits
description: Malign landvaettir whose lords take captured Julius for amusement and who can suppress a captive's Gift.

name: Biarg spirits
description: Healing/protective spirits to whom ond (Creo, Corpus or Vim vis) is offered; one sustains Asta's daughter.

name: Jotunn spirits
description: Spirits called upon by giants through Jotunn Affinity.

name: Fylgja
description: Guardian spirit that warns a galdrakona of approaching danger.

name: Giants
description: Icelandic giant clans who, after kin are slain, gather behind Bard to oppose the Hermetic invasion.

name: Fire giants
description: Giants led by Gull Hellirsson.

name: Lindorm
description: Serpentine dragon form Pan Caudarax adopts before diving into the sea.

name: Kraken
description: Sea monster form in which Pan Caudarax attacks the ships from below.

name: Drake images
description: Lesser dragon images Pan Caudarax sends to assess the strength of the armada.

name: Gate spirit
description: Spirit of Vindolanda's gateway that can swallow the gatestone to seal off Scartaris.

name: Ghost of Hadrianus
description: Spirit of the drowned archmagus haunting a Scottish island, who blames the Order of Odin before resting.

name: Beast of Virtue
description: Magical beast whose combat stats Host members use when shapeshifted.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House of Hadrianus and Julius; its primus demands vengeance and most crusader hoplites come from it.

name: House Guernicus
description: Hermetic House of Lavinia whose members long lobbied for action against the Order of Odin.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: Hermetic House normally joined by hedge magicians; home of Albinus, and a proposed home for the galdramen hreppur.

name: House Bonisagus
description: Hermetic House whose members theorize Bjornaer magi in animal form may evade the guardians.

name: House Bjornaer
description: Shapeshifting Hermetic House whose magi in animal form evade the guardians and ferry materials for a Hermes Portal.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House that engages with the church to have the excommunication lifted and sends emissaries to Iceland.

name: Loch Leglean
description: Tribunal of a magus who investigates Hadrianus's ghost in 1224.

name: War Tribunal
description: Special Tribunal called by Lavinia at Durenmar in 1230 to organize the Hermetic Crusade, declaring all Icelandic magicians enemies of the Order.

name: Grand Tribunal
description: Highest Hermetic tribunal to which elder magi may appeal the crusade and which may recognize the hreppur's membership.

name: Vindolanda
description: Secret covenant located in Iceland, believed destroyed three centuries ago, with a mainland site and gateway; home of the Toframanna Saga player magi.

name: Scartaris
description: Vindolanda's Icelandic complex and sanctum beneath glacial ice, target of Julius's assault.

name: Sinus Wodinis
description: Covenant of House Bjornaer magi on an island off southeast Norway, out of touch with the Order for decades.

name: Durenmar
description: Site where Lavinia calls the War Tribunal in 1230.

name: Mystic Tower
description: Crusader base conjured in Iceland's southeastern highlands and protected by the Aegis of the Hearth, later assaulted by the giants.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The Hermetic order of magi, formed on a join-or-die policy, which launches the crusade against Iceland.

name: Order of Odin
description: Rumored rival order of Norse wizards blamed for destroying Scandinavian covenants and Hadrianus's death, probably a myth.

name: Galdramen hreppur
description: Association of Icelandic galdramen led by Biorn Egilsson, targeted by the crusade and possibly integrated into the Order.

name: Hermetic Crusade
description: The pro-war crusader faction and expedition led by Julius and Lavinia against Iceland's magicians.

name: Clan of Geirrod
description: Giant clan whose Jotunn tongue Gull speaks.

name: Galdraman
description: Icelandic magician who works galdor magic by bargaining with and summoning spirits.

name: Galdrakona
description: Female galdor practitioner.

name: Seithkona
description: Icelandic seith witch, among those slain by crusaders.

name: Trollson
description: Troll-blooded Icelandic being with shapeshifting powers.

name: Hoplite
description: Combat-oriented Hermetic magi accompanying the crusade.

name: Archmagus
description: Senior magus of great power, such as Hadrianus, Julius, Lavinia and Albinus.

name: Redcap
description: Hermetic messenger who reports the discovery of Hadrianus's ghost.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic judge; Lavinia declares the War Tribunal legal as Quaesitor.

name: Primus
description: Head of a Hermetic House.

name: Hedge wizard
description: Non-Hermetic magician.

name: Toframenn
description: Icelandic term for the magi of Vindolanda.

name: Bondi
description: Icelandic free farmer.

name: Storgodi
description: Powerful Icelandic chieftain in legal terms.

name: Godar
description: Icelandic chieftains involved in peace negotiations.

name: Grog
description: Hermetic soldier/servant.

name: Companion
description: Non-magus player character type.

name: Filius
description: Apprentice/student of a magus.

name: Theban spirit master
description: Spirit-magic specialist of the Theban tradition, as Albinus is.

name: Hermetic theurgist
description: Magus practicing Hermetic Theurgy who could learn to summon landvaettir.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Warding ritual; a modified version gives +75 magic resistance to the armada ships and protects the crusader tower.

name: Kill the Living Air
description: Spell cast spontaneously with vis that badly drains Vindsvall's Might.

name: Leap of Homecoming
description: Travel spell letting magi escape to home.

name: Hermes Portal
description: Ritual creating a portal; crusaders build one in the southeastern highlands to move forces.

name: Clenching Hand of the Crushed Heart
description: Spell; six vis-backed castings incapacitate Gull.

name: Dwarf-forged warhammer
description: Gull's magical battle hammer, head over 1000 lbs, with the Break Wards power able to shatter the Aegis of the Hearth.

name: Spirit bottle
description: Device Albinus uses to capture Vindsvall.

name: Gatestone
description: Stone of Vindolanda's gateway that the gate spirit can swallow to seal the passage.

name: Casting tokens
description: Tokens from Aegis casters allowing Pan Caudarax to bypass the wards.

name: Weather Mastery
description: Vindsvall's power to generate any weather effect up to 12th magnitude.

name: Spiritual Form
description: Power letting guardians and Host become material or immaterial and travel at 100 times speed.

name: Shapeshift
description: Power/ability to change form or size, used by the Gray Bull, the Host and Gull (dragons).

name: Grant Might
description: Host power granting temporary Might to the guardian.

name: Heal Guardian
description: Host power healing the guardian one Health level per 10 Might.

name: Spell Powers
description: Host power creating spell effects equal to permanent Might.

name: Jotunn Spells
description: Gull's power to invoke fire magics directly using Stamina.

name: Immunity to Fire
description: Gull's immunity to heat and flame from his Jotunn Affinity.

name: Break Wards
description: PeVi power of Gull's warhammer that dispels wards with successive strikes.

name: Furious Attacks
description: Attacks usable against multiple opponents in a round without penalty.

name: Guardians of Iceland
description: Ancient bound protectors of Iceland against hostile magic: Pan Caudarax, Vindsvall and the Gray Bull.

name: Twilight
description: State Hadrianus falls into after botching a spell; his ghost later reaches final Twilight.

name: Magic Might
description: Measure of a magical creature's power.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Protection against magic, provided by Parma, Aegis, or landvaettir bargains.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic magic resistance; magi may teach it to galdramen.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power used to boost spells; called ond in Iceland.

name: Certamen
description: Magical duel; Julius wins certamen deciding the War Tribunal dispute.

name: Code of Hermes
description: Law of the Order under which hreppur membership would make the conflict illegal.

name: Hermetic Oath
description: Oath sworn to join the Order of Hermes.

name: Landvaettir bargains
description: Deals galdramen make with spirits that can give magic resistance.

name: Galdor magic
description: Icelandic spirit-invoking magic of the galdramen, possibly integrated into Hermetic Theory.

name: Spell song
description: Galdor chant sustaining a Biarg spirit.

name: Song Talent
description: Galdraman ability determining attendant spirit Might.

name: Ol-spirit
description: Part of a galdraman's soul, torn by Julius's spell.

name: External Soul
description: Giant trait keeping the soul outside the body; Gull and his son possess it.

name: Interfering with the mundanes
description: Hermetic crime the crusaders commit by killing mundanes.

name: Forfeit immunity
description: Hermetic status; Icelanders killing magi not under it are outlaws.

name: Outlawry
description: Icelandic legal penalty for raids and killings.

name: Renunciation
description: Hermetic expulsion; crusaders or Vindolanda magi may be renounced.

name: Excommunication
description: Papal sanction on Christian Hermetic members sought by Bishop Magnus.

name: Toframanna Saga
description: Saga setting from Land of Fire and Ice centered on Vindolanda.

name: Night of Tears
description: Night when crusaders slay the inhabitants of twelve farmsteads harboring magicians.

name: Hermetic Theory
description: Hermetic magic theory into which Albinus may integrate galdor.

name: Hermetic Theurgy
description: Spirit-summoning art that galdramen may be taught.

name: Spontaneous magic
description: Unprepared spellcasting.

name: The Gift
description: Magical talent that Yfel spirits can suppress.

name: Regio
description: Magical dwelling of Gull's son.

name: Cathedral magic schools
description: Icelandic clerical sorcery schools closed by investigation.

name: Wards
description: Protective magic against fire, mundane weapons, spirits.

name: Jotunn Affinity
description: Giant magical ability to work with Jotunn spirits; Gull's is with Fire.

name: Transform
description: Giant ability; Gull's specialty is trolls.

name: Survival
description: Gull's is specialized in volcanoes.

name: Climb
description: Gull's is specialized in mountains.

name: Great Weapon
description: Gull's is specialized in warhammer.

name: Thrown Weapon
description: Gull's is specialized in molten metal.

name: Speak Jotunn
description: Giant language skill.

name: Potency
description: Boosts Gull's Jotunn Affinity.

name: Premonitions
description: Foresight talent common among Icelandic magicians.

name: Visions
description: Foresight talent.

name: Divination
description: Foresight talent.

name: Latin
description: Language of the Order; Biorn calls out in it.

name: Creo
description: Technique of creation.

name: Rego
description: Technique of control.

name: Muto
description: Technique of transformation.

name: Perdo
description: Technique of destruction.

name: Intellego
description: Technique of perception; Lavinia specialty.

name: Ignem
description: Form of fire; Julius specialty.

name: Vim
description: Form of magic itself.

name: Herbam
description: Form of plants.

name: Corpus
description: Form of the body.

name: Mentem
description: Form of mind.

name: Auram
description: Form of air/weather.

name: Animal
description: Form of animals.

name: Dominion
description: Divine realm whose power tamed the Gray Bull.

name: Magic
description: Realm of magic of spirits, guardians and vis.

name: Infernal
description: Realm suspected as source of Order of Odin's powers.

name: Faerie
description: Landvaettir could be presented as faeries.

name: Iceland
description: Remote Norse colony guarded by ancients, target of the Hermetic crusade.

name: Bergen
description: Port from which Hadrianus sailed.

name: Scottish Isles
description: Where Hadrianus's body washed up and haunted.

name: Skalholt
description: Cathedral seat where the Gray Bull was captured.

name: Snaefellsnes
description: Icelandic peninsula where Vindolanda lies.

name: Dagverdara
description: Vindolanda's farmstead.

name: Norway
description: Location of Sinus Wodinis.

name: Helluland
description: Destination of fleeing trollsynir and giants.

name: Bremen
description: Archbishopric journeyed to by Magnus.

name: Rome
description: Where the Pope is petitioned.

name: Scandinavia
description: Norse lands where covenants were destroyed.

name: Icelandic highlands
description: Where the Gray Bull wanders; southeastern highlands host the Hermes Portal.

name: Western quarter
description: Region of Iceland where crusaders hunt witches.
